functions.name: facedetect_cnn
functions.signature: int* facedetect_cnn(unsigned char* result_buffer, unsigned char* rgb_image_data, int width, int height, int step);
functions.description: Runs CNN-based face detection on a BGR image and writes detection results into the caller-provided result_buffer. Returns a pointer to the result data within result_buffer. Typical usage: allocate a 0x20000-byte buffer, pass a BGR 3-channel image buffer with dimensions and row stride, then parse results from the returned int* per libfacedetection’s format. Notes: despite the parameter name, comments state the input must be BGR (3 channels), not RGB.
requirements: result_buffer must point to writable memory of size exactly 0x20000 bytes.
rgb_image_data must point to a valid BGR image buffer with 3 channels.
width, height must be positive integers.
step must be the number of bytes per image row (>= width*3 for tightly packed BGR).
The function writes into result_buffer; the caller must ensure the buffer’s lifetime spans the call and subsequent result parsing.
Return value is an int* pointing into result_buffer; caller should not free it and should not assume ownership beyond parsing.

functions.name: myAlloc
functions.description: Allocates an aligned block of memory sized to at least ‘size’ bytes. Alignment depends on platform SIMD configuration (_MALLOC_ALIGN). Intended to back CDataBlob allocations and other internal buffers.
requirements: size must be the number of bytes to allocate; should be nonzero for meaningful allocation.
Returned pointer must be freed only with myFree_ (or via the myFree macro wrapper used in this codebase).
The allocation may be aligned to 128/256/512 bytes depending on compile-time flags; callers that depend on alignment should respect these defines.

functions.name: myFree_
functions.description: Frees memory previously allocated by myAlloc. In this codebase, the myFree macro wraps myFree_ and nulls the caller’s pointer.
requirements: ptr must be a pointer returned by myAlloc (or null).
Do not call myFree_ twice on the same allocation without re-allocation.
After freeing via the myFree macro, the original pointer lvalue is set to 0; when calling myFree_ directly this does not occur.

functions.name: convolution

functions.description: Applies a convolution using the provided Filters<float> (supports pointwise 1x1 or depthwise 3x3 per Filters settings) to inputData, optionally applying ReLU. Returns the resulting feature map as a CDataBlob<float>.
requirements: inputData must be a properly initialized CDataBlob<float>.
filters must be initialized with dimensions compatible with inputData (channels must match; filter type supported by Filters).
If do_relu is true, ReLU activation is applied after convolution.

functions.name: convolutionDP

functions.description: Performs a depthwise separable convolution: a pointwise (P) and depthwise (D) combination as configured by filtersP and filtersD, optionally followed by ReLU. Returns the resulting feature map.
requirements: inputData must be initialized and non-empty.
filtersP must be configured as pointwise (1x1).
filtersD must be configured as depthwise (3x3).
Filter channel counts must be compatible with inputData and each other.
If do_relu is true, ReLU activation is applied after the combined operation.
